Name: Base
Description: What every server or client needs, copied first with every application: the C:\SCRIPTS root folders, the common functions (C:\SCRIPTS\Functions\*.ps1), the scripts settings (Data\Settings\Scripts*.json: DFS path, inventory server) and, through DependsOn, the PSM Frontend (PSMFrontendScriptsSync), whose install step is listed first for every application. The deployment tools (Installs folder, Connect-AdminShare, Copy-FilesToServer, Install-ServerModule, Set-ScriptSignature) stay on the setup machine. Can also be run on its own (with a server added) to prepare a new machine.
